Recorded claim:
A D319397 review reported a race when `mSuppliedPasswords` was shared across authentication channels and keyed only by origin, realm, and username. Because `PREVIOUS_FAILED` describes one channel's earlier prompt, another channel could replace the stored entry before failure handling and have its credential deleted. The proposed channel-scoped state and two-channel test were review recommendations; runtime tests were not run in the record. Recheck the current source before applying them.

Provenance: 58954cea479bcd4855595131e4a4bab37bbbe929be5f88c9f8c1c6f4f2a063ec. Original evidence IDs: 9a900033f8ae271e4b19a87c1ce1be0529f147541ba246c6771a6938ac00ca2a.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.

title: Recorded lesson: Keep failed credentials with their channel
